text.k01: [shouting playfully] Hey, over here! [laughs] …Honestly, you get lost every single year.
text.k03: [laughs] That yakisoba stall is scorching. [sighs] …Way too many people. Let's go up.
text.k04: [exhales] Phew. [softly] …We used to come up here a lot, the two of us.
text.k05: [teasing] You're hot, right? I'll fan you.
text.k07a: [laughs softly] Yes, yes, princess. …Honestly, what am I going to do with you.
text.k07b: [teasing] Nope. [softly] Tonight, let me do it.
text.k08: [cheerfully] I got shaved ice. Matcha with red beans. [teasing] …Here, say aah.
text.k09b: [laughs softly] Don't be shy. …Come on, it's melting.
text.k10: [mischievously] Hey. Did you know your breath goes cold after shaved ice?
text.k11: [whispers] …See? Cold, right? [chuckles softly] …Your face is red.
text.k12: [softly] We watch the fireworks together every year, but this year—
text.k13: [whispers] …This year, I wanted to watch them not as your childhood friend. …Right beside you.
text.k15a: [whispers] …Next year, and the year after. [chuckles softly] Keep the place next to me free.
text.k15b: [whispers] …Forever, then. I'm not going back to being just your childhood friend.
